description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code that manages the whole Didit identity verification platform over the API: programmatic account and application setup, API keys, workflows, verification sessions (create, retrieve, list, approve, decline, resubmit, correct data, AML hit review, PDF, share, delete), bulk imports, questionnaires, block/allow lists, users (KYC) and businesses (KYB) with AML monitoring and biometric templates, KYB registry lookups, billing and top-ups, branding, and webhook destinations with signature verification. Use when someone needs to create a Didit account or API key, build a verification workflow, create or poll verification sessions, review or resubmit a session, manage users, businesses or lists, check or top up credits, configure webhooks, or verify Didit webhook signatures.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
